entries.text: Real-world reference meshes ingest programmatically: CC0 .glb -> sidecar /assets/mesh (pure-python glTF parser) -> EditableMesh AddVertex/AddTriangle -> CreateMeshPartAsync -> save_mesh; glTF is METERS so scale ~x3 to studs; study the import for proportions/silhouette then build ORIGINALS - never ship non-CC0 expression.

Sourcing rule: MECHANICS from any game are fair to study and recreate (L4D director pacing, Souls telegraphs, RoR2 spawn credits - systems are not expression); ART/models/names/audio only from CC0/owned sources; Cube for man-made props, ingestion pipeline or author_mesh for the rest.
